Examples include frost wedging, abrasion, and exfoliation.
Frost wedging occurs when water freezes in cracks, expanding and breaking the rock.
Abrasion involves physical grinding by particles, such as wind-blown sand or moving water.
Exfoliation is the peeling off of outer rock layers due to pressure release.
